title: Boolean Fourier threshold identity
statement: For every natural number $n$, define $\tau_n=2\sqrt{n}\,2^{-n/2}$. Then the Boolean cube $\{-1,1\}^n$ satisfies $|\{-1,1\}^n|\tau_n^2/2=2n$.
